notes.title: Shadows of Larth
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32854465/06e708d6b6dc8b4c7a0bc6d0b88e5d4af1d9af00.jpg

Greetings SOY community,

Today I'm sharing with you the upcoming release of my second title, Shadows of Larth.
An action game with a core combat mechanic based on a triple stance motion, that you can use to combine deadly attacks.

The game will offer a unique experience regarding combat, exploration and upgrade systems as the following : 


 An Epic fantasy Story inspired by Medieval to Bronze age Mediterranean culture
 Unique visuals crafted and digitally sculpted by hand with realistic and dynamic lighting
 Fluid and fast paced combat system tested and built as the "Core Game Mechanic"
 Diverse world and enemies, explore cities,forests,ruins,dungeons ...
 8 directional dodge and roll even when you are locked on to a target
 RPG Dialogue narratives with multiple choice with each NPC you meet
 Up to 15 Marked Ability to unlock


Please don't hesitate to support this title and wish-list before launch on February the 20th

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
A new update is live now with a full mechanic plus abilities as the following:

 Sprint Plus 
By holding  "Shift"  or  "RT"  you can now sprint faster .

 Power Slide 
By Pressing  "ALT"  or  "RB" while on ground or jumping will boost slide you up
toward the direction of your choice.
Boost Slide while jumping is more powerful.


 Trial Helper 
For certain trials you will find the Blue Stones, if you find the trial too hard, you can kneel before the Stones and the Trial will be auto-solved and the gates will open.
Using the trial helper will not grant you the Steam Achievement related to that trial.


 Reset to Last Checkpoint 
If you are stuck and you want to go back to the last checkpoint you can now press "R" or "Y" on the Controller to reset back.


 Localization full rework 
The localization has been reworked completely from scratch, with an additional culture "Simplified Chinese".

In the hope that your Yalmrith Experience become even better and more fun
